metadata.description: Cowork-first starter scaffolding: process discipline, knowledge management, delegation patterns, a personal-companion track, a personalized daily news digest, and a fintech regulatory issue-spotter — all sitting on top of a shared notes-vault substrate that auto-bootstraps on first need and grows from every conversation. Distributed as zips attached to GitHub releases — install via Cowork's Customize → Browse plugins → upload custom plugin file. Works for any kind of structured work, not just coding.

plugins.name: welcome
plugins.description: Top-level marketplace orientation. One slash command (/welcome:tour) plus a value-first opening that names three concrete user moments (decide / reflect / fintech triage) and invites the user into theirs, in any language. No upfront feature list; catalog only on request. Read-only — writes nothing, invokes nothing without consent. Recommended first install for new users.

plugins.name: process-skills
plugins.description: Six domain-agnostic process skills: brainstorming (idea → validated design), planning-projects (staged plan with gates), executing-plans (drive a plan to done with evidence-of-done), evidence-first-investigation (figure out why before proposing what), review-document (holistic 30-second-rule review), peer-review-deliverable (review what's new against a baseline). Plus /process-skills:tour for the read-only walkthrough.

plugins.name: vault-librarian
plugins.description: Substrate plugin for basic-harness — auto-bootstraps a notes vault on first need, recalls relevant prior pages before each substantive skill runs, and appends new pages after. Three internal sub-skills (vault-companion-ensure / vault-companion-recall / vault-companion-append) that reflection-session, business-mentoring, news-digest, and fintech-legal-triage call as helpers. One user-facing command (/vault-librarian:bootstrap-vault) for explicit setup with four persona-tuned schemas (researcher / writer / generic / personal). Cross-platform — Claude Code Desktop and Cowork, macOS and Windows. Companion to the upstream obsidian-wiki plugin; delegates to obsidian-wiki:ask for recall when installed, grep fallback when not.

plugins.name: delegation-agents
plugins.description: Three model-pinned worker subagents (bulk-reader on Haiku, document-rewriter and draft-generator on Sonnet) plus a dispatching-parallel-agents skill. Lets a parent session on Opus offload bulk reading, editing, and drafting to cheaper, faster models. Domain-agnostic — works for research, writing, project management, analysis.

plugins.name: personal-coach
plugins.description: Personal-use companion: persistent profile across sessions, CBT-style reflection (not therapy), business-decision frames with grading, morning briefing. Value-first onboarding — one short opening, then engages a real situation. Vault auto-bootstraps on first save via vault-librarian's vault-companion-ensure sub-skill (shared with news-digest and fintech-legal-advisor). Reflection and decision-journaling now recall prior entries (Phase 0.5) before each session, so the journal compounds — graded prior decisions feed pattern context into new ones. Multilingual. Hard limits enforced.

plugins.name: news-digest
plugins.description: Personalized daily news digest for Claude Cowork. Two skills (news-preferences + news-digest) and one setup command. Captures topics, sources, exclusions, language, format, cadence, and an open-questions watchlist; produces a dated digest filtered strictly against those preferences. Refuses generic headlines — without preferences, the digest does not run. Cites every item; never fabricates. Phase 1.5 vault recall surfaces prior digests on each open-question watchlist item so today's framing reads as a continuity update ('since the last digest, ...') rather than a cold start. Saves to <vault>/News/ via vault-companion-append; falls back to ~/.claude/news/ if no vault.

plugins.name: fintech-legal-advisor
plugins.description: Fintech regulatory issue-spotter for Claude Cowork — KYC/AML, payment licensing, MiCA / crypto, GDPR, customer contracts, marketing claims, sanctions exposure. A fintech-specific complement to Anthropic's Claude for Legal (whose practice-area plugins cover general commercial / corporate / privacy / IP / litigation, but not fintech regulation). Strongly recommends installing Claude for Legal alongside (Cowork → Customize → Browse plugins → Legal) and declares regulatory-legal as a soft dependency. With Claude for Legal MCP connectors granted, the plugin prefers them: Westlaw / Practical Law for live primary-law verification; Box / iManage / NetDocuments / Docusign as contract sources; Microsoft Word for tracked-change output. Phase 0.5 vault recall surfaces prior triages on the same (jurisdiction × activity) cell, so a recurring EU/payments triage builds up [[MiCA]] / [[PSD2]] / [[GDPR]] backlinks across <vault>/Legal/ over time. Citation grounding is a hard rule. Setup command wires a Cowork Routine on the chosen source for high-volume non-sensitive triage. Issue lists, never verdicts. Take-to-counsel block on every output. Not legal advice.
